{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the Netherlands|Cuisine of the Netherlands]]

== Ingredients ==
* 5 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]] [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], quartered
* 3½ lbs [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], cut into pieces
* 2 lbs [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 cups [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]], [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]]
* Add cheese, salt, and pepper to your liking

== Procedure ==
# Cook potatoes in pan of water, adding salt to taste, until done.  Drain.
# Cook carrots, onions and ham, adding a small amount of salt, until carrots are done. Drain, reserving water from carrot, onion, and ham pot.
# Mash all ingredients, adding enough of reserved juices from carrots to reach a mashed potato consistency. Add 2 to 3 chunks of butter while mashing, to taste.
